Download Rupok

The free whiteboard for teachers, as a desktop app for Windows, Mac and Linux. Or open it in Chrome, Edge or Safari on any device: same board, no install.

Download the latest release

Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit. The installer adds Rupok to the Start menu.

Download .exeor .msi

Ubuntu, Debian, Mint and others, 64-bit. Or the AppImage for any distribution.

Download .debor AppImage

Phones, tablets, Chromebooks

No installer needed: Rupok runs in the browser. Install it as an app to open it from your home screen.

Open the boardInstall as an app

Release notes and every file on GitHub.

Install as an app

On a phone, tablet or Chromebook, the web app works like an installed one: its own window, on the home screen. (It still needs internet to start; for fully offline use, get the desktop app.)

Android, Chromebook, Windows

Open rupok.app/board in Chrome, Edge or Safari, open the browser menu and choose Install app (or Add to Home screen).

iPhone and iPad

Open rupok.app/board in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.

A note on the warnings

The installers aren’t code-signed yet, so your computer may ask once before it opens Rupok. That’s expected; signed installers are coming soon.

  • Windows: if SmartScreen says “Windows protected your PC”, choose More info, then Run anyway.
  • Mac: right-click Rupok in Applications, choose Open, then Open again. Or open System Settings → Privacy & Security and choose Open Anyway.

System requirements

Windows
Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit
macOS
macOS 11 Big Sur or later, Apple silicon or Intel
Linux
64-bit; .deb for Debian and Ubuntu, AppImage for other distributions
Browser
A recent Chrome, Edge or Safari (any OS), with WebGL2 or WebGPU
Hardware
Any smartboard, interactive panel, laptop or tablet; a pen is optional
Account
None
